newsitem.title: USA: Rockwell makes new high-bandwidth division.
newsitem.headline: Rockwell makes new high-bandwidth division.

text.p: Rockwell International Corp said Monday its semiconductor systems unit formed a new division to consolidate its high-bandwidth communications chip business.

Rockwell's new network access division combines the central-site portion of Rockwell's 56Kbps modem chip business and the high-speed digital communications portion of the company's Brooktree division business.
Rockwell said it acquired Brooktree in September, 1996.
The new division also will focus on developing and marketing complementary products in the high-speed local area network (LAN) and wide area network (WAN) markets, Rockwell said.
